title: Collections Desk Reference: Late Payment Charges Taken Out of the Arrears of Payment Arrangements
content:
**Collections desk reference — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**
**Late payment charges taken out of the arrears arranged**

Which late payment charges are taken out of the arrears arranged on acceptance follows the collection standing of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account on the acceptance day. The charges taken out are subtracted from the past-due amount stated on the offer.

| Outstanding disconnect notice on the acceptance day | Unexpired medical certificate on the acceptance day | Late payment charges taken out of the arrears arranged |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | every late payment charge billed in the twelve months ending on the acceptance day |
| yes | no | the late payment charges billed in the three months ending on the acceptance day |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

**Terms.** A disconnect notice is *outstanding* when the service account shows a disconnect notice date. A medical certificate is *unexpired* when the medical certificate expiry date on the service account is the acceptance day or later. The late payment charges are those billed on the service account, added together, by their billing date within the window.

**Hypothetical account:** a past-due amount of $520.00 on the offer; late payment charges of $9.00 billed two months before the acceptance day and $8.00 billed seven months before.
- Notice and unexpired certificate: $17.00 is taken out, leaving arrears arranged of $503.00.
- Notice, no unexpired certificate: $9.00 is taken out, leaving $511.00.
- No notice: nothing is taken out; the arrears arranged remain $520.00.
